Description

The Admin Saw is an admin tool obtainable only by using a Spawn Menu. Like the name implies, it's a tool used for ease of testing for tree sawing. It has maxed out stats, capable of instantly processing a full tree, having no charge and 50 studs of range.

Saws are tools used to cut off the bark of trees, increasing their price. Essentially, Admin Saw is a better handheld version of a Sander.

Appearance

Admin Saw, like any other admin items, uses the same color pallete as them. Blade is colored pink with legacy foil material applied to it. The handle is colored white with legacy wood material applied to it.

Trivia

  • Early version of Admin Saw used to have a decal of the internet meme "Giga Chad" plastered over it's headpiece. DevShurikeno used to have a special variant of the Admin Axe, with a decal of...Twitch streamer XQC morphed into a Pepe the frog holding a pink heart plastered over it's headpiece.
  • Current design of Admin Saw uses the design first introduced in older Oaklands iteration - Oaklands Legacy.
  • When first added, the saws all had the same stats, including Admin Saw, which made it rather useless. It can be seen in the First Oaklands Trailer.
  • The stats for Admin Saw, like Admin Pickaxe, are not representitive of it's actual power.
  • The admin saw as well as other admin tools are publicly usable in "Oaklands 100 Players", however this game is rarely unlocked by the developers.
